commit.subject: LU-20239 obdclass: add lu_buf_check_and_shrink()
commit.message:
LU-20239 obdclass: add lu_buf_check_and_shrink()

Introduce lu_buf_check_and_shrink() to shrink the buffer to the
requested size. Use it in mdd_dir.c to shrink the buffer to the
actual size of the xattr.

Fixes: bbe23406f6 ("LU-19712 mdd: Inherit pin xattr from parent")
